breakage_notes: Concurrency was designed but not executed with real Celesto sandboxes due to SDK unavailability. With the free Celesto Cloud trial only one retained sandbox is allowed simultaneously; the local open-source runtime requires Linux/KVM which is not available on this Windows host. Observed limits: sandbox name uniqueness is enforced by the sbx-[a-z0-9]{8,} pattern generator using uuid4 hex. Rate-limit and cost blow-up would need to be verified with real credentials and a paid top-up.
